sentences.sentence: The strangest character who Alice met was the White Queen.
The strangest thing that the Red Queen did was give Alice a dry biscuit.
Alice felt confused when she was talking to the Red Queen.
The strangest place was the train where Alice met the goat.
The Red Queen who helped Alice was the silliest character in the story.
Alice met the Lily when she was walking in the garden.
I think the poem that Tweedledee recited was silly.
The strangest moment in the story was when Alice went through the mirror.
